fact: The April 2020 roadmap says that since 1 January 2019 the Ministry of Finance requires civil servants' salaries to be paid to a bank account, 98.7% paid electronically as of March 2019, while pensions were 11% electronic.
title: Numérisation des Paiements de l'Etat du Niger (P2G/G2P): Feuille de Route
publisher: World Bank Group / République du Niger
